scope: Documentation index of substantive original-source reproduction difficulties, separate independent experiments, and evidence-recovery failures. Not a claim that every incidental CI cancellation is a scientific experiment.

entries.problem: Original source was not identified at the initial 14 October search; independent reconstruction used a separate MP-SPDZ 0.3.9 compatibility target.
entries.resolution: Professor's 14 October Zenodo link enabled checksum-pinned original-source replay on MP-SPDZ 0.3.6. Earlier independent experiments remain separately labeled.

entries.problem: Author OS/Python unpinned, requirement.txt differs from README spelling, tiktoken not directly pinned; local namespace confinement unavailable.
entries.resolution: Recorded exact evaluator-only dependencies and compiler/runtime pins; downloaded programs executed only in restricted non-root network-none Docker. Full generation dependencies remain untested.

entries.problem: Initial full final-stage run lost the SPDZCoder math artifact after an incomplete source download; first aggregate was incomplete.
entries.resolution: Retry only failed jobs in attempt 2; preserve failed attempt and later complete 1252-record dataset separately.

entries.problem: Final-stage source replay has compiler failures, 66 GPT-4 missing-input failures, four nonexistent-player-2 requests, three final timeouts and five archived/fresh acceptance disagreements.
entries.resolution: Retain original inputs, 313-task denominators, all attempt streams and original weak oracle; do not replace failures with later successes. Root causes for numerical disagreements remain unproven.

entries.problem: Stage2 native replay yields 147 compile failures, 34 completed-runtime oracle rejects, 14 retrying candidates and 18 timed-out attempts; two terminal compiler errors unclassified.
entries.resolution: Preserve all 626 candidates/644 attempts, exact category taxonomy, three archived/fresh disagreements and raw stderr, including unclassified errors.

entries.problem: Seven original category jobs succeeded but original aggregation failed because the root path contained an extra stage2-full prefix.
entries.resolution: Separate artifact-only recovery reused the same seven ZIPs and succeeded without rerunning candidates. Historical run stays failure; workflow path fix and regression tests prevent recurrence.

entries.problem: Original substring pass oracle ignores returncode; signed-relative tests accept known wrong results; one native template lacks a functional oracle.
entries.resolution: Preserve original evaluation as the benchmark estimand. Separately demonstrate four false positives and disclose missing/faulty tests; do not label native acceptance universal correctness.

entries.problem: Released stage1 early-break and repair candidate/feedback resets conflict with idealized method; saved states omit intermediate messages; 50 branch source changes have zero saved repair tokens.
entries.resolution: Map exact original source and seven authentic saved-state exemplars. Missing chronology and token billing are explicitly unavailable, never synthesized.

entries.problem: Secret multiplication rewriting can be unsound with zero folding/rebinding/unsupported types; mixed lower_bound disclosure remains outside supported scope.
entries.resolution: Restrict transformation, preserve unchanged fallback and review regression history. Tested two authentic translations preserve outputs and reduce observed explicit intermediate opening events 50 to zero, with extra multiplication/communication costs.

entries.problem: Four native acceptance flips occur on source-identical controls; 626-pair aggregate rates therefore cannot establish a causal accuracy gain from the two actual changes.
entries.resolution: Preserve all flips, costs and uncertainty; 16 original-only repeated executions confirmed at least one unstable decision (3/4 accepts). Underlying cause remains unproven.

entries.problem: Original Azure deployment gpt-4 is not pinned to an independently accessible historical revision; full prompts/responses and repair history absent; no paid model access authorized.
entries.resolution: NOT REPRODUCED. Author-provided historical provenance and transcripts would recover history; verified provider/model and separate cost approval could support a clearly labeled NEW experiment. OpenAI retirement does not prove Azure availability.

entries.problem: No attributable historical SPDZCoder without-refactoring candidate corpus or prompt route recovered. Matching UniTrans counts are a different system. Six original inputs fail direct Python parsing.
entries.resolution: NOT REPRODUCED. Preserve 498-file/35-group search, embedded Git/Zenodo lineage and 313 raw input/instruction pairs. Do not substitute baseline flags or silently alter/exclude six inputs.

entries.problem: R8 checker initially validated only stage2 counts and accepted altered provenance/category/disagreement fields; main status and 14 October documents were stale.
entries.resolution: PR13 repairs fail-open provenance and category/disagreement accounting, adds 13-family cross-project documentation, and preserves intentional RED mutation runs followed by GREEN execution at45a51e6. Raw audit39493312330 rechecks31pinnedZIPs without native/model execution. Independent review found no critical/important defect at45a51e6.
